Now Playing

Headphone EQ

Shape the sound with a ten-band graphic equalizer. A separate AutoEQ layer applies correction for your headphone model.

Album downloads

Stream at home and choose which albums to carry. Full offline experience with traditional downloads and an optional rotating mix of other albums.

Books and podcasts

All of your books and podcasts are available from Audiobookshelf. Stream anything you like or download to keep it with you. Progress syncs automatically when you connect.

Internet radio

Featured Stations puts FIP, KEXP and SomaFM within a turn of the wheel. Your Navidrome stations appear alongside the featured list.
